articles.title_zh: French weekend protests to be limited to union demos only, says Macron
facts_zh:
French weekend protests to be limited to union demos only, says Macron
- Published
Only authorised union protests will be allowed in French towns and cities on Saturday, President Emmanuel Macron has said, after demonstrations across the country turned violent last weekend.

Speaking as some cities including Lyon and Nice imposed complete bans, Macron said "illegitimate" protests would not be allowed but unions would be offered alternative routes so that businesses could be protected.
Big demonstrations against the high cost of living and school conditions were overshadowed last Saturday by riots and looting that saw business and historic buildings destroyed.

all_titles.en: French weekend protests to be limited to union demos only, says Macron

articles.title_zh: Teacher in Oregon shooting said she pretended to be dead to survive
facts_zh:
Teacher in Oregon shooting said she pretended to be dead to survive
- Published
Some readers may find this article distressing.
A 54-year-old teacher who survived a mass shooting at an Oregon elementary school said she pretended to be dead so the gunman would not shoot her again.
Becky Drury, a teacher at Silver Rail Elementary School, said in a statement shared with US media that as she tried to shut her classroom door, the gunman shot her and she fell to the floor.

articles.title_original: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
articles.title_zh: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
facts_zh:
Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
- Published
Yemen's Houthi movement has said it carried out an attack on an airport in eastern Saudi Arabia on Wednesday evening, which Saudi authorities said killed two people and injured eight others.
The Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation identified those killed at King Fahd International Airport in Dammam as a Saudi citizen and an Indian resident.
It did not say what type of attack occurred, but the Iran-backed Houthis said on Thursday that the airport was one of the sites they had targeted with drones and missiles over the previous 48 hours.

all_titles.en: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say

articles.title_original: Ilhan Omar says 'bizarre' pre-dawn raid on her home is forcing her to move out
articles.title_zh: Ilhan Omar says 'bizarre' pre-dawn raid on her home is forcing her to move out
facts_zh:
Ilhan Omar says 'bizarre' pre-dawn raid on her home is forcing her to move out
- Published
Minnesota Representative Ilhan Omar has said she can no longer live in her Washington DC home after it was searched by federal agents last week, fearing her address has been exposed after the raid.
"With the death threats that I deal with, it's not, it's no longer going to be feasible to be in that house and have my kids," she told MS NOW, external.

In Omar's first public interview since the pre-dawn search of her home, she detailed how Homeland Security Investigations agents seized over a dozen items, including cell phones and notebooks, as part of an investigation.

all_titles.en: Ilhan Omar says 'bizarre' pre-dawn raid on her home is forcing her to move out

articles.title_zh: Ex-prosecutor charged with treason in Mexico over US drug raid
facts_zh:
Ex-prosecutor charged with treason in Mexico over US drug raid
- Published
Federal prosecutors in Mexico have charged a former state prosecutor with treason for allowing US agents to join a raid on a suspected drugs lab in April without proper authorisation.
César Jáuregui Moreno served as attorney general of the northern border state of Chihuahua from 2023 to this year.
The involvement of Americans came to light after two US agents said to have worked for the CIA died in a car crash in Chihuahua along with two Mexican law enforcement officers.
